format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-button id="b-old" type="ghost" status="danger" icon-left="add" tightness="high" icon-position="right" text="Старые имена"></sf-button>

probes.title: draws one native button named by its text; the host has no box

steps.check: (() => { const host = document.querySelector('#b-text'); const b = host.querySelector('button.sf-button'); return getComputedStyle(host).display === 'contents' && b && b.type === 'button' && b.textContent.trim() === 'Продолжить' && b.classList.contains('sf-button--default') && b.classList.contains('sf-button--primary') && b.classList.contains('sf-button--size-1'); })()

probes.title: a text child is the label
an icon-only button takes the host's aria-label
the old names and values still draw, each noted with its dates
probes.covers: aliases.json type, icon-left, tightness, ghost (now link to ghost), danger (now error to danger), right

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#b-old button'); return b.classList.contains('sf-button--link') && b.classList.contains('sf-button--danger') && b.classList.contains('sf-button--error') && b.classList.contains('spacing-comfortable') && Boolean(b.querySelector('sf-icon[icon=add]')); })()

probes.title: a click sends sf-button-press once and the native click still bubbles

steps.script: (() => { window.__clicks = 0; document.addEventListener('click', () => { window.__clicks += 1; }, {once: true}); return true; })()

probes.title: Enter on the focused native button sends press
a disabled or loading button sends no press

steps.script: (() => { window.__presses = 0; document.addEventListener('sf-button-press', () => { window.__presses += 1; }); document.querySelector('#b-off button').click(); document.querySelector('#b-load button').click(); return true; })()

steps.check: window.__presses === 0 && document.querySelector('#b-off button').disabled && document.querySelector('#b-load button').disabled && document.querySelector('#b-load button').getAttribute('aria-busy') === 'true'

probes.title: expanded writes aria-expanded, absent says nothing
a value off a list draws the default
a link takes target and rel; a new tab with no rel says noopener noreferrer; a button carries neither

steps.check: (() => { const a = (id) => document.querySelector(id + ' a.sf-button'); const tab = a('#b-tab'), rel = a('#b-rel'), self = a('#b-self'); const btn = document.querySelector('#b-btn-target button.sf-button'); return Boolean(tab && rel && self && btn) && tab.getAttribute('target') === '_blank' && tab.getAttribute('rel') === 'noopener noreferrer' && rel.getAttribute('rel') === 'noopener' && self.getAttribute('target') === '_self' && !self.hasAttribute('rel') && !btn.hasAttribute('target') && !btn.hasAttribute('rel'); })()

probes.title: status error reads as danger and appearance link as ghost, each noted; both keep their drawing classes
probes.covers: settings.status danger, settings.appearance ghost, aliases.json error, link

steps.check: (() => { const e = document.querySelector('#b-err button'); const l = document.querySelector('#b-link button'); return e.classList.contains('sf-button--danger') && e.classList.contains('sf-button--error') && l.classList.contains('sf-button--link'); })()

probes.title: a cycle shows its current label, names it, steps on a press, wraps, sends change and announces; pressed beside it is ignored

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#b-cyc button'); return b.textContent.trim() === '1×' && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Скорость: 1×' && b.title.includes('1,5×') && !b.hasAttribute('aria-pressed'); })()

(() => { const h = document.querySelector('#b-cyc'); const b = h.querySelector('button'); return h.getAttribute('value') === '1.5' && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Скорость: 1,5×' && h.querySelector('.sf-button-announce').textContent.trim() === 'Скорость: 1,5×'; })()

probes.title: height picks the size's tightness step: low, default, high, highest stand ever taller, default is the size's own height, the sides grow with the height, a value outside the list reads as default

steps.check: (() => { const b = (id) => document.querySelector(`#${id} button`); const h = (id) => b(id).getBoundingClientRect().height; const pad = (id) => parseFloat(getComputedStyle(b(id)).paddingInlineStart); const ids = ['b-h-low', 'b-h-default', 'b-h-high', 'b-h-highest']; const rising = ids.every((id, i) => i === 0 || h(id) > h(ids[i - 1])) && ids.every((id, i) => i === 0 || pad(id) > pad(ids[i - 1])); const halves = ids.every((id) => Math.abs((pad(id) - pad('b-h-default')) * 2 - (h(id) - h('b-h-default'))) < 0.5); return rising && halves && h('b-h-default') === h('b-text') && h('b-h-bad') === h('b-text') && b('b-h-high').classList.contains('sf-button--height-high') && ![...b('b-h-default').classList, ...b('b-h-bad').classList].some((c) => c.startsWith('sf-button--height-')); })()
